policyZh: 校准记录必须区分程序模型工程尺寸、资料推算尺寸和经测量核验尺寸。任何 verified 数值都必须绑定可追溯测量来源和误差记录。
policyEn: Calibration records must distinguish procedural engineering dimensions, reference estimates, and measured verified dimensions. Every verified value requires traceable measurement sources and an error record.

engineeringEnvelope.method: Computed from the current procedural L3 asset bounding envelope; not a surveyed building dimension.

dimensions.methodZh: 由当前程序模型左右最外侧构件包围盒计算，仅用于后续定标前的工程基准。
dimensions.methodEn: Computed from the outermost procedural geometry as an engineering baseline before calibration.

dimensions.methodZh: 包含主体屋面和入口台阶的当前工程包围盒，不代表建筑测绘进深。
dimensions.methodEn: Current engineering envelope including roof and entrance stair; not a surveyed building depth.

dimensions.methodZh: 从台基地面到当前顶部构件的程序模型高度，尚未通过图纸或测量核验。
dimensions.methodEn: Procedural height from plinth ground to the current finial; not verified by drawings or measurement.

dimensions.methodZh: 依据公开正立面与照片将中央塔轴线设为局部坐标 X=0；只确认对称轴关系，不确认绝对尺寸。
dimensions.methodEn: Public elevation and photographs align the central tower to local X=0; this confirms symmetry only, not absolute dimensions.

dimensions.labelZh: 主楼八角屋顶结构跨度 X
dimensions.labelEn: Main octagonal roof structural span X
dimensions.methodZh: 依据开放获取建筑学论文中由武汉大学档案馆结构图纸整理的18m×18m跨度；运行时按屋顶几何包围盒自动校准。
dimensions.methodEn: Uses the 18 m by 18 m span reported from Wuhan University archival structural drawings; runtime geometry is scaled from its bounding span.

dimensions.labelZh: 主楼八角屋顶结构跨度 Z
dimensions.labelEn: Main octagonal roof structural span Z
dimensions.methodZh: 依据开放获取建筑学论文中由武汉大学档案馆结构图纸整理的18m×18m跨度；运行时按屋顶几何包围盒自动校准。
dimensions.methodEn: Uses the 18 m by 18 m span reported from Wuhan University archival structural drawings; runtime geometry is scaled from its bounding span.

dimensions.methodZh: 论文与武汉大学新闻网刊载资料均记载中央大厅净高9.6米。该数值仅作为室内控制高度，不用于推算建筑总高。
dimensions.methodEn: Both the academic paper and a Wuhan University News publication state a 9.6 m clear height. This constrains the interior hall only and is not used to infer total building height.

errorRecord.method: Runtime bounding-box span calibration on each LOD roof level
Exact-height calibration overlay control line; interior geometry compliance is pending a dedicated interior model

核对4767平方米与6234平方米两种公开面积数据的统计口径
取得可定标的正立面、侧立面或建筑平面图
建立符合工字形平面描述的四座附楼控制框架
